title: Plan a question as free sub-questions (the planner of research.decompose)
description: Variant (A) of 13b ST13: view.research_plan writes the sub-questions, code.normalize_plan makes the plan safe. The answer is the plan itself, not an answer to the question: the planner can be measured alone (suite `plans`) before it is run.

origin.note: variant A of the planner; measured with the suite plans
